_doc: The ONE tool catalog (docs/flows/tools.md is the human contract, this file the machine one). Each entry declares WHAT a tool is — its carrier (communication / github-mcp / none) and, for communication tools, the payload field spec. WHO may call it is agent.json's job: the agents/<profile>/agent.json 'tools' array lists availability and may only contain names declared here. Consumers: communication-channel/src/spec.mjs (registers the communication part), src/mcpjson.mjs (the github-mcp part becomes GITHUB_TOOLS), bridge/bridge.mjs (route-tool = manifest ∩ communication).

save_plan.description: Save or update the plan: goals, scope, acceptance criteria and steps. The Orchestrator publishes the plan as a comment in the issue and runs plan approval. This call publishes nothing to GitHub — publication is the Orchestrator's act.

request_clarification.description: Request missing information from the User via the Orchestrator. The flow PARKS until a @bot /resume command resumes it as a NEW Run. This call publishes nothing to GitHub — publication is the Orchestrator's act.

report_blocker.description: Report a blocker you cannot resolve independently: cause, context and possible solutions. The flow PARKS until an @bot /resume command resumes it as a NEW Run. This call publishes nothing to GitHub — publication is the Orchestrator's act.

submit_review_comments.description: Submit review findings. The Orchestrator publishes them to the PR and assigns the fixes to the Coder (a fixing Run). This call publishes nothing to GitHub — publication is the Orchestrator's act.

request_decision.description: Escalate a review issue that cannot be resolved without user input: issue, context and possible solutions. The flow PARKS until a user_decision event resumes it as a NEW Run. This call publishes nothing to GitHub — publication is the Orchestrator's act.

report_bug.description: Report a product bug, test-code issue or missing tests: summary, reproduction steps and test results. The Orchestrator publishes the report as a comment in the issue and returns control to Development. This call publishes nothing to GitHub — publication is the Orchestrator's act.

report_env_issue.description: Report an environment or access problem blocking test execution: what happened and what is needed. The flow PARKS until an @bot /resume command (after the User restores the environment) resumes it as a NEW Run. This call publishes nothing to GitHub — publication is the Orchestrator's act.

request_criteria_clarification.description: Request clarification of acceptance criteria / expected behavior; the Orchestrator routes the answer to the Planner. The flow PARKS until a user event resumes it as a NEW Run. This call publishes nothing to GitHub — publication is the Orchestrator's act.

report_tests_passed.description: Report that all tests passed, with a summary; the Orchestrator then checks the manual acceptance policy. This call publishes nothing to GitHub — publication is the Orchestrator's act.

report_completion.description: Explicit, parameterless signal that your work is done — the MANDATORY final call of every Run; a Run that ends without it has failed. Payloads travel through the specific tools; this call only marks the end. It publishes nothing to GitHub — publication is the Orchestrator's act.

submit_pr_description.description: Carry your result to the Orchestrator: the title and body of the Pull Request the Orchestrator creates after report_completion. You never write to GitHub. This call publishes nothing — publication is the Orchestrator's act.
